confidence_note: Subjective, uncalibrated row-correctness estimates. 0.60 reflects a complete deterministic calculation with explicit mappings but incomplete independent validation; 0.40 reflects additional mapping inference exposure. The numbers are not fitted probabilities, not derived from Hospital 1 precision, and are a limitation of this submission. Exposure includes inferred lines in the invoice or in other records for the same patient; global utilisation and mapping uncertainty may still remain.
